title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Pie Chart on Time Spent Listening to Audio in Three Scenarios
prompt: The pie chart below shows the percentage of total listening time spent on different types of audio content in three simulated scenarios: a university lecture, a self-guided museum tour, and a city bus journey. The data is based on a simulated study of 200 adult learners. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先仔细阅读饼图标题、图例和百分比，确保理解每个场景中各类音频内容所占比例。写作时，先概述主要特征（如哪个场景中说明性内容占比最高），再对三个场景进行对比，引用具体数据支持你的描述。不要表达个人观点或解释原因。建议用20分钟完成，写至少150词。
